name: DARCL2
hypothesis: Exact original DARCL2 fallback, one Arcane Shot and no Krush; unchanged policy

name: RJC
hypothesis: H1: T2-T5 standalone Knife Juggler is a deterministic play when no friendly unsilenced Juggler is already present. The response-mode exclusion currently skips the entire turn search when this card is ranked first, so alternate development and key clears are never compared. Allow this one play class in response projection, retaining all existing random-trigger exclusions, the original Juggler route, 350 own nodes, width 10, depth 9, 6x48 reply nodes and original time limits. Predict greater route recall and positive fresh Astra paired full-game gain; refute if recall does not reach rescued routes, or changed actions fail to produce net full-game wins. Deck and mulligan fixed.

name: PRR
hypothesis: H2: Existing T2-T5 public-response candidates miss longer-term hand/board tradeoffs. A small source-grouped paired residual ranker applied only after the unchanged six bounded visible replies can rank rescued routes higher without increasing search nodes. Parent DARCL2, deck/mulligan fixed; Warlock public class only, T2-T5 only. Refute by nonpositive independent source continuation or fresh full-game net gain.

name: DA2
hypothesis: H3: In early Warlock board fights, the single three-mana random Deadly Shot often cannot precisely remove a two-health key attacker while also developing a minion. Replace only that card at slot 23 with a second one-mana Arcane Shot; keep the other 29 slots, all tactics, mulligan and search budgets identical to DARCL2. Predict positive fresh Astra macro gain from more precise clear-plus-development opportunities. Refute with nonpositive natural full-game gain, failed independent confirmation, or excessive loss of large-target removal in the frozen guardrail. This is the only new card substitution tested this sprint, not an assertion that card exposure implies causal value.

name: EHC
hypothesis: H4: The public effect model transfers a killed Loot Hoarder into one extra opponent hand card, but race evaluation drops that future resource while rewarding removal of its deathrattle value. Price opponent public hand_size symmetrically with our hand using the existing turn_hand coefficient 0.973, without predicting card identities. This should reduce overvalued draw-deathrattle clears and visible bounce lines while preserving high-attack clear alternatives. Parent DARCL2, one scoring expression only, identical deck/mulligan/search caps. Refute if actual policy continuations do not produce repeatable net rescues, or fresh full games fail to show Astra gain. Unlike PRR this does not learn/reweight board, race, secret or own-hand features; unlike TRPLY it adds no reply or recovery nodes.
